name: Apple Ui Designer
summary: Redesign mobile app UI to feel unmistakably Apple-like, iOS-forward, and native. Use this skill when building iOS apps, applying Apple Human Interface Guidelines, or creating native-feeling mobile interfaces with SF Pro typography, translucency, and system-like components.

name: Ios Glass Ui Designer
summary: Redesign mobile app UI to feel unmistakably iOS-native with modern Apple-like glass materials (translucency, blur, depth). Use this skill when designing iOS-first interfaces that leverage iOS material hierarchy (ultra-thin/regular/thick), SF Pro typography, safe-area patterns, and system component behaviors—without overdoing glass effects.
